name: CollectionDeclaration
description:
CollectionDeclaration is a named collection of records with typed
 fields, constraints, and access grants.

fields.name: Name
fields.description:
Collection name, unique within the datastore.

 Format: lowercase snake_case (e.g. "bookings", "schedule_exceptions").

fields.name: Description
fields.description: Human-readable description of what records in this collection represent.

fields.name: Fields
fields.description: Typed field declarations for records in this collection.

fields.name: Uniques
fields.description: Uniqueness constraints, enforced by substrate indexes.

fields.name: Checks
fields.description: Single-record check constraints, evaluated on every insert and update.

fields.name: Exists
fields.description: Cross-collection constraints requiring a matching record to exist.

fields.name: NotExists
fields.description: Cross-collection constraints requiring no matching record to exist.

fields.name: Grants
fields.description:
Per-role access grants for records in this collection.

 Deny by default: a role with no grant on a collection has no access
 to it.
